mechanisms.board_and_councils: Reg338/96s4 (addedReg361/96): geographic containment and minister specifies applicability; vesting without further deed. Orders place application/rescission inside conditional 'On an amalgamation' clauses.
mechanisms.new_council: Reg338/96s3: appointment of members of new council is statutory trigger, subject to containment.
mechanisms.designated_corporation: HAA s16: written consents, corporate special resolution, minister-certified proof and registrar notification; this is a separate mechanism, not automatically the statutory council route.
